admin_events_fields_check.name: admin_events_fields_check
admin_events_fields_check.value:
case "admin_events"."kind"
    when 'override_set' then "admin_events"."switch" is not null and "admin_events"."scope" is not null and "admin_events"."new_value" is not null
    when 'override_cleared' then "admin_events"."switch" is not null and "admin_events"."scope" is not null and "admin_events"."old_value" is not null
    when 'group_created' then "admin_events"."group_id" is not null and "admin_events"."new_value" is not null
    when 'group_renamed' then "admin_events"."group_id" is not null and "admin_events"."old_value" is not null and "admin_events"."new_value" is not null
    when 'group_described' then "admin_events"."group_id" is not null and ("admin_events"."old_value" is not null or "admin_events"."new_value" is not null)
    when 'member_added' then "admin_events"."group_id" is not null and "admin_events"."user_id" is not null
    when 'member_removed' then "admin_events"."group_id" is not null and "admin_events"."user_id" is not null
    when 'setting_set' then "admin_events"."setting_key" is not null and "admin_events"."setting_month" is not null and "admin_events"."new_value" is not null
  end

admin_events_scope_target_check.name: admin_events_scope_target_check
admin_events_scope_target_check.value:
"admin_events"."scope" is null
    or ("admin_events"."scope" = 'app' and "admin_events"."group_id" is null and "admin_events"."user_id" is null)
    or ("admin_events"."scope" = 'group' and "admin_events"."group_id" is not null and "admin_events"."user_id" is null)
    or ("admin_events"."scope" = 'user' and "admin_events"."user_id" is not null and "admin_events"."group_id" is null)

commander_support_prose_check.name: commander_support_prose_check
commander_support_prose_check.value: ("commander_support"."prose" is null) = ("commander_support"."prose_input_hash" is null) and ("commander_support"."prose" is null) = ("commander_support"."prose_prompt_version" is null)

deck_suggestion_items_one_card_check.name: deck_suggestion_items_one_card_check
deck_suggestion_items_one_card_check.value: "deck_suggestion_items"."add_oracle_id" is not null or "deck_suggestion_items"."cut_oracle_id" is not null

deck_synopses_outcome_check.name: deck_synopses_outcome_check
deck_synopses_outcome_check.value:
("deck_synopses"."status" = 'pending') = ("deck_synopses"."outcome" is null)
        and ("deck_synopses"."outcome" is null or "deck_synopses"."outcome" in ('survived', 'refused', 'malformed', 'upstream_busy', 'upstream_rejected', 'timeout', 'interrupted'))

flag_overrides_target_check.name: flag_overrides_target_check
flag_overrides_target_check.value:
("flag_overrides"."scope" = 'app' and "flag_overrides"."group_id" is null and "flag_overrides"."user_id" is null)
    or ("flag_overrides"."scope" = 'group' and "flag_overrides"."group_id" is not null and "flag_overrides"."user_id" is null)
    or ("flag_overrides"."scope" = 'user' and "flag_overrides"."user_id" is not null and "flag_overrides"."group_id" is null)

friend_invites_one_end_check.name: friend_invites_one_end_check
friend_invites_one_end_check.value: (case when "friend_invites"."redeemed_at" is null then 0 else 1 end) + (case when "friend_invites"."declined_at" is null then 0 else 1 end) + (case when "friend_invites"."revoked_at" is null then 0 else 1 end) <= 1
